programme.desc: S5 E12 — Olivier Giroud We follow the remarkable journey of Olivier Giroud, from his Premier League days with Arsenal and Chelsea to Champions League glory and beyond. A World Cup winner known for his elegance and resilience, Giroud's career has taken him from London to Milan, then to LA, and now back home with a move to Lille. As he begins this new chapter, we reflect on the highs, the hurdles, and the legacy of one of football's most underrated and enduring strikers.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E13 — Christian Benteke We catch up with Christian Benteke in Washington, where the powerful Belgian striker now leads the line for D.C. United. From his early days in Belgium to his explosive arrival in the Premier League with Aston Villa, followed by big moves to Liverpool and Crystal Palace, Benteke's journey has been one of raw talent, resilience, and reinvention.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E14 — Thiago Silva We join Thiago Silva in his native Brazil to reflect on his remarkable footballing journey; from overcoming life-threatening illness early in his career to becoming one of the world's most respected defenders. We explore his late-career success in the Premier League, his influence on and off the pitch and life at current club Fluminense.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E15 — Edwin van der Sar Edwin van der Sar has faced down pressure on the biggest stages in world football, but his toughest battle came after retirement. In 2023, the legendary goalkeeper suffered a life-threatening brain haemorrhage. In this episode Edwin opens up on his recovery and looks back on his career at the top that redefined goalkeeping. From Champions League glory with Ajax and Manchester United to his commanding presence in the Premier League.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E16 — David Luiz Flamboyant, fearless, and unforgettable - David Luiz lit up the Premier League with his unique style. From Champions League triumphs at Chelsea to high-stakes drama at Arsenal, his career was packed with silverware and great stories. In this episode, we explore the man behind the headlines: a leader, a teammate, and a born entertainer. Now back in Brazil, Luiz opens up on life after the Premier League and his plans for the future.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E17 — Maya Yoshida In this episode, we look back at Yoshida's journey from Japan to England's top-flight, his role as a leader for club and country, and the cultural bridge he helped build along the way. Now in the final stages of his playing career with LA Galaxy in the USA, we catch up with him as he looks to inspire the next generation, both in Japan and around the world.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E18 — AFC Bournemouth: 'From the Brink' In 2024/25, AFC Bournemouth smashed their club record with 56 Premier League points, but less than 20 years earlier, they were drowning in debt and fighting for survival. This is the story of a club that defied the odds, silenced the doubters, and rose to become a certified Premier League contender, with their eyes set on Europe.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E19 — Yaya Touré We chart the remarkable journey of one of the Premier League's most iconic midfielders, Yaya Touré, from his humble beginnings in Bouaké, Ivory Coast, to his rise through European football's elite clubs. We sit down with Touré to discuss his development at ASEC Mimosas, his path playing with the likes of Monaco and Barcelona, and his eventual arrival at Manchester City, where he became a driving force behind the club's transformation into a football powerhouse.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E20 — Duncan Ferguson We sit down with Duncan Ferguson to discuss the fierce, passionate, and often unpredictable career of one of Everton's most legendary figures. From his early days in Scotland to his turbulent arrival in English football, PL Stories focuses on Ferguson's deep bond with the blue half of Merseyside; a connection built on loyalty, grit, and unforgettable moments. Through highs, lows, goals, and red cards, we explore how he became more than just a player to Evertonians.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E21 — Sandro Tonali We follow the rise of one of Italy's most gifted midfielders and his journey to Premier League stardom at Newcastle United, Sandro Tonali. From his early days at Brescia, where his talent drew comparisons to Italian greats, to his development at AC Milan and eventual move to St. James' Park, we trace Tonali's evolution on and off the pitch.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E22 — José Fonte We travel to Portugal to sit down with José, as he reflects on his years in the Premier League, his development as a leader, and the role that English football played in shaping a career that would eventually lead to international glory with Portugal.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E23 — Luc Nilis Still regarded as a legend in his native Belgium, Luc Nilis lit up the Pro League and Dutch football, winning numerous titles and cups with Anderlecht and PSV Eindhoven. His 2000 move to Aston Villa looked set to make him a Premier League star, but instead, it almost ended in tragedy. We catch up with the former striker to hear his incredible story and discover how his new role in coaching has become his biggest challenge yet.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E26 — Premier League Hall of Fame We sit down for an exclusive interview with the first of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Eden Hazard. A celebrated footballer who lit up the English top-flight during his illustrious career; a winner of multiple domestic and European honours, he became a true legend of the Premier League era. He reflects on his rise to the top, the moments that defined his career, and the immense pride he feels at joining the elite ranks of the Premier League's greatest ever players.
programme.title: Premier League Stories
